governingRule: Domain authority outranks recency. Proposed, draft, research, rejected, historical, and audit artifacts cannot authorize implementation.

authorityClassDefinitions.owner-approved: Accepted normative product contract for its exact boundary; execution still follows its named ticket and authorization state.
authorityClassDefinitions.owner-approved-direction: Accepted product or sequence direction; no implementation permission.
authorityClassDefinitions.owner-approved-architecture: Accepted architecture direction for the named domain; implementation and activation remain separate.
authorityClassDefinitions.proposed: Reviewable planning candidate awaiting named human acceptance.
authorityClassDefinitions.draft: Working decomposition that cannot control retained work.
authorityClassDefinitions.research: Evidence or technology disposition only; code use requires the adoption policy and phase authority.
authorityClassDefinitions.rejected: Not safe or accepted for retained implementation.
authorityClassDefinitions.historical: Preserved context that cannot control current requirements, implementation, acceptance, release, or activation.

website-source.label: Website source, candidate, compiler, mutation, and promotion

acceptanceRecord.evidence: Pre-existing owner-approved authority carried into this reconciliation; this record grants no implementation authorization.

website-source.boundary: This manifest grants no implementation permission. Existing Page IR tickets OBX-001, OBX-002, OBX-010 through OBX-015, OBX-020 through OBX-025, OBX-029 through OBX-031, OBX-040 through OBX-042, OBX-050, and OBX-051 retain only their separately recorded ticket state; one page-ir-v1 or template-v1 source is fixed per run.

canvas.label: Canvas interaction

acceptanceRecord.evidence: Pre-existing owner-approved authority carried into this reconciliation; this record grants no implementation authorization.

canvas.boundary: Approved interaction direction; Page IR supersedes older mutation assumptions and each later slice needs its own authorization.

website-lifecycle.label: Cross-system website lifecycle

acceptanceRecord.evidence: Owner-approved intake-to-re-delivery direction recorded in this task; phase implementation remains separately gated.

website-lifecycle.boundary: Intake through monitoring and re-delivery direction; execution is phase-gated.

program-order.label: P1 through P8 program order

acceptanceRecord.evidence: Owner-approved program sequencing recorded in this task; no phase inherits implementation authorization.

program-order.boundary: Sequence authority only; no phase inherits implementation authorization.

acceptanceRecord.evidence: Owner-approved appointment architecture boundary recorded in this task; implementation and activation remain unauthorized.

appointment-acquisition.boundary: Appointment topology placement is deferred to a separate accepted ADR. Independent verification, implementation plan, tickets, tests, and activation authorization remain required; website topology, rollback, re-delivery, and release remain non-owners.

engineering-operating-system.label: Senior-engineering workflow and gap register
engineering-operating-system.boundary: Planning and contribution policy pending owner acceptance. Every related governance and contributor surface in this domain is proposed, grants no implementation authority, and remains subordinate to accepted domain authority; exact Grok review or a labeled authorized fallback is evidence only.

release-1.label: Narrow Release 1 and re-delivery contract

acceptanceRecord.evidence: Owner acceptance of the Release 1 packet recorded 2026-09-02 in docs/governance/acceptances/2026-09-02-release-1-packet-acceptance.json; grants for implementation, provider selection, deployment, client invitation, and appointment activation are all withheld.

release-1.boundary: Owner-approved Release 1 and re-delivery contract, accepted 2026-09-02 with every grant withheld. This manifest still grants no implementation permission; implementation follows the scoped registry at docs/plans/one-box-master/00-authority/scoped-implementation-authorizations.json. The section 10 unresolved decisions stay open: the deployment adapter, the client-review authentication and session mechanism, the hosting origin and system-of-record boundary, the frozen browser and device set, the first admitted Page IR and template-v1 fixture corpus, the named owner and independent verifier for each gate, the first-adapter monitor observations, and the accepted Release 1 qualification tool set.

compatibility.label: Release 1 compatibility and capability support

acceptanceRecord.evidence: Owner acceptance of the Release 1 packet recorded 2026-09-02 in docs/governance/acceptances/2026-09-02-release-1-packet-acceptance.json; grants for implementation, provider selection, deployment, client invitation, and appointment activation are all withheld.

compatibility.boundary: Owner-approved Release 1 support and capability matrix, accepted 2026-09-02 with every grant withheld. Implementation follows the scoped registry. The unresolved compatibility decisions stay open: the exact Apple-silicon OS, runtime, and browser versions with the supported client-review browser set; the first admitted Page IR and template-v1 fixture corpus; the review-session transport and authentication mechanism; the unselected deployment provider and its adapter; monitor probes and the manual-operator boundary; and numeric accessibility, SEO, and performance targets, which remain unset until baseline evidence.

target-topology.label: Target desktop/cloud topology
target-topology.boundary: ADR 0001 remains executable authority until this ADR is accepted and each migration is separately authorized.

program-security.label: Full-product threat model
program-security.boundary: Planned controls are not current implementation claims; the local API threat model remains current for loopback runtime.

program-evaluation.label: Program evaluation strategy
program-evaluation.boundary: Existing Page IR evaluations remain authoritative for their scope; new program oracles are planned until implemented.

supply-chain.label: Dependency, model, skill, plugin, worker, and asset supply chain
supply-chain.boundary: No new production code use until an accepted ledger entry and enforcement evidence exist.

program-tickets.label: Program planning and future phase backlog
program-tickets.boundary: Proposed and blocked planning tickets do not authorize implementation.

mpa-reconciliation.label: MPA-001 through MPA-011 correction record
mpa-reconciliation.boundary: Finding disposition record only. It cannot overrule the domain documents it cites or authorize code use.

operating-environment.label: Team, agents, drafts, collaboration, desktop, browser, media, and stack expansion
operating-environment.boundary: E0 through E8 remain draft decomposition. Only the separate OBX-AUTH-ATF-001 foundation-v1 record grants narrow retained implementation; it does not authorize the broader domain.

embedded-browser.label: Embedded browser
embedded-browser.boundary: The rewritten plan preserves EB-001 through EB-021 as open implementation gates. No retained desktop, native view, browser, profile, capture, CDP, agent-action, packaging, signing, updater, or distribution work may begin until EB-001 closes first and the separately authorized slice's required rows have named-human and independent-verifier evidence.

technology-adoption.label: External technology and model research
technology-adoption.boundary: The shortlist owns planning dispositions; the adoption ledger and phase gates control any code use.
